description: This file contains code for simulating a hanging rope and related physics, including classes for vectors, points, springs, and ropes, as well as animation logic for a hangman game scene with images and user interaction.

classes.name: Vector
classes.description: Represents a 2D vector with methods for vector arithmetic, normalization, and limiting magnitude.

classes.name: Point
classes.description: Represents a point mass with position, velocity, acceleration, and rendering capabilities.

classes.name: Spring
classes.description: Models a spring connecting two points with methods to calculate spring force and rendering.

classes.name: Rope
classes.description: Simulates a rope composed of particles and springs between two anchors, with update and initialization methods.

methods.name: setDelta
methods.description: Calculates the time delta between frames for animation timing.

methods.name: animateRope
methods.description: Starts the animation loop for the rope simulation.

methods.name: hang
methods.description: Simulates the hanging motion by removing particles from the ropes.

methods.name: pullUp
methods.description: Simulates pulling up the victim by adjusting rope physics and playing animations and sounds.

methods.name: resetLeftRope
methods.description: Resets the left rope to its initial state.

methods.name: resetMidRope
methods.description: Resets the middle rope to its initial state.

methods.name: resetCanvas
methods.description: Resets the entire scene and ropes to initial state.
